title: Upstream Alaveteli Engagement
description: Communicate and collaborate with the upstream Alaveteli/mySociety maintainers and individual instance operators (FYI.org.nz, RightToKnow.org.au, WhatDoTheyKnow.com, etc.) about fyi-cli's multi-jurisdiction client work: introduce the project, share API-coverage/health-check findings discovered during the audit, propose upstream doc fixes, establish etiquette/rate-limit norms for bulk archival use, and explore an official client listing.
